personalization.title: Personalization
personalization.description: Custom instructions for OnePiece and CLI agents, and memory preferences for OnePiece, applied to every session on this device.
personalization.customInstructions.title: Custom Instructions
personalization.customInstructions.descr: Give OnePiece and CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode) extra context and response preferences that apply to all of their conversations.
personalization.customInstructions.enabl: Turn off to stop applying custom instructions to new generations without losing the saved text.
personalization.customInstructions.style: e.g. Always answer in Chinese. Lead with the conclusion.
personalization.customInstructions.about: e.g. I'm a backend engineer working mainly in Rust and TypeScript.
personalization.memory.title: Memory
personalization.memory.description: Control what OnePiece and CLI agents remember across sessions, shared by every agent, and manage what's already been remembered.
personalization.memory.enabledDesc: Let OnePiece and CLI agents save facts from conversations and use them in future sessions, shared across every agent. Turning this off also stops using memories already saved.
personalization.memory.toolAssistedDesc: Allow automatic memory extraction for OnePiece sessions that used shell, file, or MCP tools. Explicitly asking it to remember something is never affected. CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode) extract memories independently of this toggle.
personalization.memory.confirmDelete: Delete this memory? This cannot be undone.
personalization.memory.confirmReset: Delete every saved memory, shared across OnePiece and all CLI agents? This cannot be undone.
